publicFacts.detail: Unity Gardens is a fictional residential community in Abuja, Nigeria. It began as a modest development on the outskirts; homes were occupied gradually and small businesses grew around everyday needs.

Ordinary unresolved questions at the start include how to care for shared spaces, keep access roads maintained and make everyday services dependable and affordable. These are background concerns, not reports of failures or urgent tasks.

At the start of the simulation, apartment blocks and standalone homes share a neighbourhood with market trading, transport, repairs, supply work, care, teaching and tailoring. Residents have different means and priorities; ordinary trade and services are functioning.

background.public: Developed a market livelihood serving everyday customers as local commerce took shape.
background.private: Experience managing stall stock taught her to compare collecting supplies herself with seeking help. Past acquaintance does not settle whom she should ask today.
